name: BABILong
intro: BABILong基准用于测试语言模型在极长文档中跨事实推理的能力。包含20种多样的推理任务，如事实链、简单归纳、演绎、计数及列表/集合处理。这些任务本身具有挑战性，且当所需事实分散在长文本中时难度更大。
org: AIRI, DeepPavlov.ai, and London Institute for Mathematical Sciences
build_method: bAbI任务程序化生成、PG19背景句交错、token长度控制
metric: 按任务与上下文长度统计的精确答案准确率
eval_feature: 长文本, 防污染, 思维链
scale: 20个bAbI推理任务；0K、4K、8K、16K、32K、64K、128K、512K、1M、10M token预生成切分；部分循环记忆实验外推至50M token
build_method_en: Programmatic bAbI Generation, PG19 Sentence Interleaving, Token-Length Control
intro_en: BABILong extends the 20 synthetic bAbI reasoning tasks by hiding their ordered facts among naturally ordered PG19 book sentences. It provides reproducible context-length splits from 0K to 10M tokens and evaluates direct long-context models, chunk- and sentence-retrieval RAG, and curriculum-trained recurrent-memory models, including selected extrapolation experiments up to 50M tokens.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.10149v2: all 20 bAbI tasks; PG19 books as natural long-form background; insertion of task facts and distractors while preserving both PG19 sentence order and task-logical order; GPT-2-tokenizer length control; reproducible 0K-to-10M-token splits; parallel direct, RAG-C-512, RAG-S, and RMT/ARMT/Mamba evaluations; and selected 50M-token extrapolation. The three evaluation protocols remain independent: direct QA1-QA5 uses 1,000 examples per task and length through 32K and 100 beyond; RAG uses 50 examples per task and length and reports RAG-C/RAG-S separately; recurrent and 50M experiments use the full test set through 1M, 100 examples at 10M, and selected runs at 50M. Their sample counts are never pooled into a shared scoring node.
